list.title: Bounties | Ninja Labs
list.description: Find paid work from Injective ecosystem sponsors, ship useful pieces, and collect on-chain proof for your Ninja portfolio.

apply.title: How applying works | Ninja Labs
apply.description: Some bounties accept work directly. Others require sponsor approval before you can submit.

list.heading: Bounties
list.intro: Find paid work from Injective ecosystem sponsors, ship useful pieces, and collect on-chain proof for your Ninja portfolio.
list.payoutNote: Sponsors post in any token such as INJ or USDC. Rewards are sent as-is, so builders swap on their own; Ninja Labs does not run a platform-side swap.

filters.emptyBody: Try a different category or clear the search.

apply.heading: Bounty types — submit-type vs apply-type
apply.intro: Some bounties accept direct submissions; others require sponsor approval before work starts.

submitType.heading: Submit-type
submitType.body: Anyone works and submits directly. This is best for small deliverables where the sponsor can judge completed output after the fact.
submitType.flow: The Submit button is shown directly, the same as on the bounty detail page.
submitType.none: No submit-type bounties are open right now.

applyType.heading: Apply-type
applyType.body: Submission opens only after sponsor approval. This is useful for larger work where sponsors want to review the builder first.
applyType.flow: Apply → application form → sponsor review → after approval, Submit is enabled.
applyType.none: No apply-type bounties are open right now.

empty.title: No open bounties right now
empty.body: New sponsor opportunities will appear in the bounty marketplace.

apply.statusNote: Apply-type adds one approval step before submission; the sponsor reviews the application first.

detail.applyFootnote: Viewing is public; applying and submitting require login. Submission unlocks only after sponsor approval.

rewardNotes.token: Sent in the original token; the builder swaps if needed.
rewardNotes.noSwap: No platform-side swap. Contracts and wallets use Injective addresses.

rewardNotesApply.flow: Flow: lock → application review → approval → submit → release.
rewardNotesApply.token: Reward is sent in {currency}; the builder swaps if needed.
rewardNotesApply.noSwap: No platform-side swap. Contracts and wallets use Injective addresses.

completionSteps.transfer: Reward transferred to the user wallet.
completionSteps.mint: Bounty NFT minted as a child proof item.
completionSteps.attach: Child NFT attaches to the user's Ninja NFT and appears in the profile portfolio.

afterApprovalSteps.unlock: Submit field unlocks for completed work.
afterApprovalSteps.reward: Reward transfer and child Bounty NFT mint happen after final approval.

detail.footnote: Viewing is public; submitting or applying requires login. Child NFTs are the portfolio proof for every completed bounty.

action.agentBody: This bounty accepts authenticated agent API requests instead of the browser submission form.
action.statusUnavailable: Your bounty status is temporarily unavailable. Please refresh and try again.
action.applySuccess: Application received. You can track it from My applications.

errors.generic: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.ALREADY_APPLIED: You already applied to this bounty.
errors.BOUNTY_NOT_OPEN: This bounty is no longer open.
errors.APPLICATION_NOT_APPROVED: Your application must be approved before submitting.
errors.SUBMISSION_FINALIZED: This submission has already been finalized.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the URLs and description, then try again.

action.applicationRejectedBody: The sponsor did not select your application for this bounty.
action.submissionApprovedBody: The sponsor approved your work for this bounty.
action.submissionRejectedBody: The sponsor reviewed your work and did not accept it. This submission is final.
action.revisionNote: The sponsor requested a revision. Update your work and submit again.
action.inReviewNote: The sponsor is reviewing your work. You can still update it before the deadline; the latest version replaces the previous one.
action.submitSignedOutBody: Paste the completed work link after signing in. Public visitors can still read every bounty detail.
action.applySignedOutBody: Submit a short application first. The submit button unlocks only after sponsor approval.
